en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing ruined waterfront buildings along a harbor. Many houses by the sea front appear burnt out, with missing roofs and damaged walls. In the background, numerous small boats and ships are visible on the water. Printed captions in French and English at the top describe the scene as ruined quay houses in Salonique/Salonica. A small website watermark (elia.org.gr) appears at the bottom.
